card.name: The word known before "as" naming
card.fires_on: The word "known" in "is/are known as" right before a technical name or label is given. A weaker secondary response is on word-start pieces like "Step" and "sympt".

modes.label: known as
modes.description: "known" after is/are/were, introducing a term that names the thing just described.
modes.example: This curve is<< known>> as a kyphotic curve.

modes.label: split word starts
modes.description: The first piece of a word broken in two, such as "sympt" in symptomatic or "Step" in Steppe.
modes.example: pyloroduodenal obstruction,<< sympt>>omatic prostatic hypertrophy or bladder-neck
